script_text: PISCES: This week the Water sign receives a truly magnificent Venus-Neptune trine activating your 5th House of romance and creativity. Early week, Monday brings Mercury square Neptune creating mental fog but heightening your intuition — avoid signing contracts. Tuesday the Moon trines Jupiter expanding emotional clarity. Wednesday your power day as the Sun trines Neptune amplifying deeply natural gifts and opening creative artistic channels. Mid-week turning point: Wednesday’s Sun-Neptune trine marks the significant energy shift. Late week, Thursday sees Mars enter your 10th House igniting career ambitions and professional recognition. Friday brings Mars square Venus relationship tensions peak, while Sunday Jupiter sextiles your sign expanding opportunities especially significantly in partnerships. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House truly. Saturday is your worst day with Mars square Venus. Weekly advice: Focus on creative projects rather than logical analysis. Follow for daily updates.
